Marina (People Ops): Quick heads-up — SF office (Embarcadero building) will be CLOSED tomorrow (Thu) due to an HVAC failure and building water shutdown. Please WFH or use one of the partner coworking desks we booked. If you absolutely need to access the office for hardware, DM me and we'll arrange escorted entry. :wave:
Alex (eng): Yikes — thanks for the notice. Do we know how long? any ETA from the landlord?
Marina (People Ops): Landlord says repairs likely 24-36 hours but could slip. We'll update if it extends. For tomorrow we reserved 8 hot desks at Covo Embarcadero and 4 meeting seats at WeWork Market St. Book here (first-come):
```
https://redwood-proxy.bookings/covo-embarcadero
```
Marina (People Ops): If you're traveling into the office and need a ride/taxi because public areas are affected, Redwood will reimburse up to $40. Submit under expense code OPS-ONCALL with receipt.
Sam (FacOps): Badge readers are still live but elevators will be limited between 8:00-10:00 while crews move equipment. Security will be onsite to escort people in/out during that window. Avoid heavy gear during that time if possible.
Alex (eng): If I need to pull the server from my rack tonight, is that allowed?
Jen (eng-sre): I'd rather not move racks in the middle of building work — if it's not urgent let's postpone. If urgent, we can coordinate a late-night pickup (post-18:00) with FacOps escort.
Sam (FacOps): Late-night pickups OK with 48h notice. DM me the rack ID and I'll add to the escort list.
Marina (People Ops): Important travel note for the upcoming London onsite (Mon–Thu next week): Our travel partner confirmed all London flights still on schedule, but a few people who planned to swing by SF before heading to London should not transit via the Embarcadero office tomorrow. If your travel itinerary touches SF on Thu/Fri, please reply here and Travel Team will re-route or reimburse reasonable changes.
Travel Team: If anyone needs to rebook flights because of this closure, email travel@redwood.com with subject "SF office closure — rebook" and include original itinerary + preferred alternative. We will prioritize requests from people flagged on the onsite attendee list.
Marina (People Ops): TL;DR/actions:
- WFH tomorrow unless you booked one of the partner desks.
- Booking link above for Covo/WeWork.
- Reimbursements up to $40 for taxi/parking (use OPS-ONCALL).
- Hardware access allowed but coordinate with FacOps (Sam) — late pickups possible.
- If your travel to London transits SF this Thu/Fri, reply here or email travel@redwood.com ASAP.
Alex (eng): Confirmed — I'll move my pickup to Friday AM. Thanks Marina. :thumbsup:
Jen (eng-sre): I'll postpone my rack work.
people-ops-bot: Building maintenance notice synced: Embarcadero HVAC outage created by vendor; next update scheduled in 4 hours.
Marina (People Ops): I'll post any updates here. Managers: please remind your teams to confirm London travel dates by EOD Friday so we can finalize rooming and flights. Thanks all! :sparkles:
